scenarios.title: Power startup check
scenarios.focus: Validate power rail startup and regulation.
success_criteria: Output remains stable under a modest load step.
notes: Prefer a vendor model when the regulator is a switching IC.

scenarios.title: USB input protection check
scenarios.focus: Confirm VBUS protection and idle biasing.
success_criteria: Normal VBUS is not clamped under nominal conditions.
Protection parts do not distort the rail during idle bias.
notes: Use DC operating point first; transient only if the model supports it.

scenarios.title: ESP32 startup and strap check
scenarios.focus: Check ESP32 reset, boot, strap, clock, and supply bias states at power-up.
success_criteria: Reset remains asserted long enough during startup.
Boot strap pins settle to the intended logic state.
Crystal and decoupling nets bias correctly at startup.
notes: This is a functional check, not a full timing-accuracy proof.

scenarios.title: RP2040 debug and BOOTSEL check
scenarios.focus: Check RP2040 boot selection, SWD access, and low-speed bias paths.
stimuli: Observe boot selection and SWD bias
success_criteria: BOOTSEL control remains in the intended default state.
SWD and reset bias networks settle cleanly.
VTREF sensing path produces a stable reference voltage.
notes: This check is aimed at low-speed control and debug paths, not firmware execution.

scenarios.title: Indicator current check
scenarios.focus: Verify LED bias current and resistor sizing.
success_criteria: LED current stays within the target range.
notes: Useful as a quick sanity check for visible indicators.

scenarios.title: Interface bias and coupling check
scenarios.focus: Validate interface biasing, VTREF sensing, and basic connectivity.
success_criteria: Interface bias nets sit at intended levels.
No obvious floating interface supply is detected.
VTREF sensing remains stable across the interface network.
notes: This is a lightweight pre-check, not a high-frequency RF simulation.

recommendations: Start with the baseline operating-point check.
Prefer transient analysis for startup behavior and DC operating point for bias checks.
